purpose: independent confirmation of efficacy-promote as a single fixed first-run root action before any further ML work

requirements: source trace elapsed time is greater than 60 and at most 120 seconds
at least one policy-eligible root decision exists
the instance was not used in the first-run pilot or cohorts A and B
selection_contract.sampling: complete enumeration of all eight instances satisfying the requirements; no active outcome or current risk label was used for selection
selection_contract.official_group_check: six instances have distinct nonempty official MIPLIB Groups and two are officially ungrouped

experiment_contract.process_isolation: one fresh Python/SCIP process per arm and seed
experiment_contract.decision_budget: at most one root cut-selection intervention in the first SCIP run of the complete solve

confirmation_gate.attributable_pair_rule: native arm must finish with optimal, infeasible, unbounded, or inforunbd status
confirmation_gate.unsafe_rule: an attributable treatment arm is unsafe when it fails to finish while its native arm finishes
checks: instance-equal mean relative LP-iteration saving is positive
more instances have positive than negative mean relative LP-iteration saving
no instance has mean relative LP-iteration saving below -0.25
confirmation_gate.passing_consequence: supports a separate family-disjoint fixed-action validation; does not yet authorize online deployment
confirmation_gate.failure_consequence: reject efficacy-promote as a generally safe fixed action and do not train an ML gate unless independent unsafe-instance support becomes materially larger
